websites.title: Websites or sitemap URLs
websites.description: A domain (sitemaps are found through robots.txt and common locations) or a direct sitemap URL. Up to 500 per run.

maxUrlsPerSite.title: Maximum URLs per site
maxUrlsPerSite.description: Stop collecting a site after this many URLs.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip sitemaps the site asks bots not to fetch. Recommended.
